propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped, branching on provider-name strings for transport, cache gating, and output mode instead of provider-agnostic seams.
Add a first-class native AWS Bedrock path via BedrockConverseModel with equivalent retry (botocore adaptive) and read-timeout guarantees driven by the same LLMConfig fields as the Anthropic path.
Replace provider-name string matching with a provider_factory hook and per-vendor ModelProfile capability flags, constructing all Provider objects only in providers.py.
Retire the _pai_check_config refusal so REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL, REBAR_LLM_API_KEY, and REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER compose through a best-effort OpenAI-compatible builder as documented.
Widen the signed verdict sidecar's model field to structured provenance recording provider, endpoint host, support tier, and effective capabilities.

The 10-change stack is physically invalid mid-chain because it grows runner.py past the 800-LOC cap before the split that shrinks it, and reordering is blocked by helper-signature and module-creation dependencies.
